topic: The worst fight of their friendship: each lists everything they hate about the other, throws back the most painful things they were told in confidence, and tries to hurt as much as possible.

text: We need to talk
ok
Not like that, actually talk. About what happened
I figured
So are you going to say anything or
I don't know what you want me to say Siobhan
I want you to explain yourself
I told you at the time why I said what I said
You told Aoife. You didn't tell me. I had to hear it from her
And not just what you said to her, what you said about me
I know
That's it?
I'm not going to pretend it was fine. It wasn't fine.
You told her I was jealous of her. That I'd always been jealous of her. Where did that even come from
because I think it's true
Right
So you've just been thinking that about me for what, years
I didn't say years
You said always been
I said it badly
Or you said exactly what you meant and now you don't want to deal with it
Maybe. I don't know. I was frustrated.
With me
with the whole thing
She was awful to me Caitlin. She said those things about my job, about where I live, all of it, and you just
You said nothing. You sat there
I know I did
And then you go and tell her I was the problem
I didn't say you were the problem
Aoife told me word for word what you said
Aoife tells people what she wants them to hear
So now you're calling her a liar
I'm saying she's not neutral
She told me you said I make everything about myself. That I exhaust you
So that's a yes
I said I find it hard sometimes. That's not the same thing.
You've been my best friend for twelve years and you're telling Aoife Burke of all people that I exhaust you
I know how it sounds
Do you
Yes. I do.
I don't think you do actually. I don't think you have any idea
Because if you did you wouldn't have done it
Can I ask you something
Go on
Do you think this friendship has been equal
What does that mean
I mean do you think we've both put the same amount in
I can't believe you're doing this
I'm asking a genuine question
Yes. Yes I do. I have been there for every single thing. I was there when your da was sick, I was there when you and Ryan split up, I took two days off work
I know you did
So what are you saying
I'm saying that when things are hard for you it takes over everything. For weeks. And I'm there, I'm always there, but it doesn't really go both ways in the same way.
Name one time I wasn't there for you

When mum was in hospital in March you called me four times that week about the thing with work. I didn't tell you to stop, I should have, but I was sitting in a waiting room and I answered every time.
I didn't know how bad it was
You knew she was in hospital
You said it was routine
It ended up not being routine
And I came over after. I brought food over.
You did. I know.
So what then
I'm not trying to make a list of who did what. I'm trying to explain why I was frustrated enough to say something stupid to someone I shouldn't have said it to.
You chose her though. That's what I keep coming back to. Of all the people
We work together now. We're around each other a lot.
I know you work together
She's hated me since fifth year. You know that.
She doesn't hate you
She told people about me and Declan. While it was still happening. I never told you the full of it because I didn't want to make you pick but it was bad.
I didn't know the full of it no
And you still told her things about me
I told her I find it hard sometimes. I didn't tell her anything else.
You told her about my mam
...I mentioned it. In passing. I didn't go into it.
Caitlin that was told to you in confidence. I haven't told anyone else. Not even my sister knows all of it.
I know. I'm sorry. I shouldn't have.
She came up to me at Niamh's thing two weeks ago and said she hoped things were easier at home now. I wanted to die. I didn't even know what she knew.
I didn't think she'd bring it up to you
Why would you tell her at all
I don't have a good answer for that
No you don't
I'm sorry about your mam. genuinely. That was wrong of me.
It's not just that though is it. It's all of it together.
I know
And you think I make everything about myself
I think sometimes when you're in the middle of something it's hard to get through to you. That's different from making everything about yourself.
That's just a nicer way of saying the same thing
Maybe
Well while we're doing this
You want to know what I find hard
go on
You go cold. Like a switch. Anytime something gets too much you just go quiet and I'm supposed to figure out what I did. It's been like that since we were sixteen.
I don't do it on purpose
I know you don't. But it happens. And then nothing gets said and it just sits there.
Fair enough

And when Ryan left you pushed everyone away for months and then when you came back it was just expected that everything would pick up normal and I'd been worried sick the whole time and there was never any
Like you never acknowledged it
That was a bad time
I know it was. I'm not saying you should have been different during it. I'm saying after.
I didn't realise you felt like that
Because you never asked
No
This is the problem isn't it. Twelve years and we're only saying any of this now.
Yeah
I'm really angry with you still
I know. You should be.
She's going to use it. Whatever you told her. She's going to use it.
Maybe. I can't take it back.
No
I don't want this to be it
I don't know what I want right now
That's fair
I need some time
Ok
At work til 6 if you were wondering why I'm not responding to anything
I wasn't going to message
Ok
Home now
How was it
Mental. Christmas stock. Someone had a go at me about a returns policy and I nearly lost it
God
Fine now. Just tired
I keep thinking about what you said about March
You don't have to do this tonight
I know I just. I really didn't know
I believe you
I would have. If I'd known. I want you to know that.
I know you would have
How is she now
She's alright. Getting there.
Good
Going to sleep. Still need that time but I didn't want to leave it weird
Ok. Sleep well.
Slept til nearly ten 😮
Needed it probably
Yeah
My sister's here making a roast and I've been put in charge of the gravy which is going to be a disaster
Don't let it go lumpy
Too late
[photo: a pot of extremely lumpy gravy]
Oh no
She's not speaking to me
Whisk
We don't have one
Fork then
Saved it mostly
Still here. She's staying over.
Ok
Hope it was good
It was actually. Nice to have company.
She doesn't know any of it by the way. In case you were wondering.
I wasn't but ok
Just wanted you to know
Appreciated
Still not ready to talk properly. But I'm glad we talked Friday.
Me too
